purpose: Where each snowcam resort publishes 24h/storm snow totals — for validating VLM/CV stake readings. endpoint_verified=true means the URL was fetched successfully during the survey.

platform_notes.vail_resorts: Beaver Creek, Breckenridge, Keystone, Vail, Northstar, Park City, Crested Butte share one CMS. No public API; numbers are server-rendered into the page as a `FR.snowReportData` JS object (Inches+Centimeters, fields: Overnight/24h/48h/7day/BaseDepth/CurrentSeason). No storm-total field. Pages 403 without full browser-like headers (Akamai).
platform_notes.alterra_mtnpowder: One shared feed serves all Alterra/Ikon resorts: GET https://mtnpowder.com/feed/v3.json?bearer_token=<token> (~3.8MB, 145 resorts incl. Aspen, Alta, Snowbird, Copper — filter Resorts[] by Name). Tokens are public, embedded in each resort's page config at https://v4.mtnfeed.com/resorts/<slug>.json. Fields incl. Last24HoursIn, Last48HoursIn, Last72HoursIn, Last7DaysIn, StormTotalIn, BaseIn, SeasonTotalIn per area (Base/Mid/Summit). Steamboat also has the simpler open https://mtnpowder.com/feed?resortId=6 (5=Winter Park).
platform_notes.powdr_dor: POWDR resorts (Snowbird, Copper, Eldora) use api.<resort>.com/api/v1/dor/* (Gatsby+Drupal 'Daily Operations Report'). snow-reports endpoint gives new snow/overnight/base plus computed 24/48/72h/7d/season.
platform_notes.opensnow: Many independents (A-Basin, Loveland, Monarch, Brian Head, Powder Mountain, Powderhorn) outsource the forecast to OpenSnow; observed totals still come from the resort itself.
